repositories.one_line_purpose: A telemetry frame bus that rate-limits streams, detects gaps and replays, and exports accepted history through Protobuf.
repositories.innovation: The design makes transport health measurable at ingestion time and retains a compact wire path instead of treating serialization as an afterthought.
repositories.evolution: It evolved from frame accounting into real Protobuf batch export and measured JSON-versus-Protobuf condensation.

evidence.label: Telemetry bus
evidence.claim: Implements per-stream ordering, rate limits, drop accounting, and Protobuf export.

evidence.label: Protobuf codec
evidence.claim: Encodes telemetry history into a real Protocol Buffers batch.

repositories.one_line_purpose: A compact propulsion-health evaluator for chamber pressure, mixture-ratio error, and vibration.
repositories.innovation: It converts heterogeneous sensor margins into a transparent health index while preserving hard RED/YELLOW/GREEN gates.
repositories.evolution: It evolved into a reusable campaign piston whose outputs can be challenged by Job-App Helix rather than consumed as an unexplained score.

evidence.label: Health model
evidence.claim: Computes weighted health and explicit status gates.

evidence.label: Tests
evidence.claim: Verifies healthy and degraded propulsion scenarios.

repositories.one_line_purpose: A ground-station planner that selects viable links, meets bandwidth demand, and preserves failover options.
repositories.innovation: It treats routing as a constrained capacity decision instead of a static station list.
repositories.evolution: It evolved into the campaign network piston that can be combined with telemetry, satellite routing, and mission-control state.

evidence.label: Ground planner
evidence.claim: Selects eligible stations by elevation, SNR, and capacity.

repositories.one_line_purpose: A dependency-aware launch sequence model that advances only when required stages are satisfied.
repositories.innovation: It turns launch progression into explicit state transitions and prerequisite checks rather than an opaque script.
repositories.evolution: It evolved into an orchestration handoff between domain evidence and campaign-level GO/NO-GO logic.

repositories.one_line_purpose: A mission-console state model that turns subsystem events into operator-facing status.
repositories.innovation: It provides a human operational surface while keeping the underlying event and state transformations inspectable.
repositories.evolution: It evolved from isolated console output into a consumer of telemetry, launch, propulsion, and ground-network evidence.

evidence.label: Mission console
evidence.claim: Aggregates subsystem state for operator review.

repositories.one_line_purpose: A satellite-mesh route selector that evaluates available paths and communication constraints.
repositories.innovation: It models routing as an evidence-bearing decision that can compose with ground capacity and mission requirements.
repositories.evolution: It evolved into the orbital communications strand connecting vehicle state to the ground-network piston.

repositories.one_line_purpose: A hybrid-autonomy model that coordinates automated decisions with bounded human oversight.
repositories.innovation: It makes authority and handoff boundaries explicit instead of presenting autonomy as an all-or-nothing switch.
repositories.evolution: It evolved into a reusable decision layer that can consume verified telemetry and mission state.

repositories.one_line_purpose: A cryogenic boil-off model for reasoning about thermal loss and propellant preservation.
repositories.innovation: It captures the relationship between time, temperature, and propellant loss in a small inspectable model.
repositories.evolution: It evolved into a thermal/propellant capability that can inform launch sequencing and readiness decisions.

repositories.one_line_purpose: A conjunction-risk evaluator that turns relative orbital conditions into a traceable response signal.
repositories.innovation: It separates risk calculation from response policy so the numerical model can be reviewed independently.
repositories.evolution: It evolved into a consumer of orbital-mechanics outputs and a provider of mission-control warnings.

repositories.one_line_purpose: A launch-site weather gate that turns environmental conditions into explicit hold or proceed evidence.
repositories.innovation: It represents weather as a composable decision boundary rather than a narrative checklist.
repositories.evolution: It evolved into an independent campaign piston that can block an otherwise healthy launch sequence.

repositories.one_line_purpose: An orbital-mechanics engine with pure physics solvers and a separate stateful planning layer.
repositories.innovation: Its Alpha/Omega split separates stateless Kepler and transfer calculations from planning and orchestration.
repositories.evolution: It evolved into a foundational provider for conjunction analysis, trajectory planning, and campaign verification.

repositories.one_line_purpose: A predictive reentry model that evaluates tile state and proposes bounded trajectory adjustments.
repositories.innovation: It combines thermal-gradient analysis, signal fusion, and an adaptive controller while keeping the demonstration boundary explicit.
repositories.evolution: It evolved from a thermal calculation into a closed-loop Alpha/Omega model connecting prediction to controlled response.

evidence.label: Predictive thermal model
evidence.claim: Implements tile-state analysis and adaptive reentry control.

evidence.label: Architecture
evidence.claim: Documents the Alpha/Omega split and runnable example.
